22019.new_name: Sequin Fringe Club Bodysuit in Silver
22019.title_note: Nightclub→Club；sequined fringed→Sequin Fringe；silver 参数上标题；S/M/L 磅制三码
22019.desc:
Sequins and fringe on the same bodysuit is a lighting strategy: the sequins catch whatever light the room offers, and the fringe moves it around. This club piece runs both in silver — the color that does the most with the least illumination — on a fitted bodysuit base that keeps the two effects anchored to a silhouette.

The fringe hangs in rows from the bust and hip lines, which are the two places movement matters most on a dance floor. The sequins cover the base fabric entirely, so the bodysuit reads as liquid from across the room and as thousands of small decisions up close.

Sizing runs by weight bands in pounds: S for 85–105, M for 105–120, and L for 120–140. In a fitted sequin piece the band is worth respecting — the fringe falls from fixed points, and the fit decides where those points sit.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: Polyester with sequin fringe
  • Style: Fitted club bodysuit
  • Color: Silver
  • Sizes: S (85–105 lbs / 39–48 kg), M (105–120 lbs / 48–54 kg), L (120–140 lbs / 54–64 kg)

Made for rooms with a bassline and a lighting budget.
22019.short: Silver sequin fringe bodysuit for club nights, fitted with fringe rows at bust and hip, three sizes S to L by weight.
22019.tkd_title: Sequin Fringe Club Bodysuit in Silver | RoseToys
22019.tkd_desc: Silver sequin fringe club bodysuit, fitted with fringe rows at bust and hip, sizes S to L for 85-140 lbs. At RoseToys.

22020.new_name: White Petal Bodysuit in Three Sizes
22020.title_note: three-point（三点式）剥；petals→Petal；Bodysuit+（含配件暗示）保守为单 bodysuit；白色属实
22020.desc:
Petal detailing on white lingerie is the bridal-adjacent version of the genre: soft organic shapes where black pieces run hardware, and a sweetness that the sheer fabric immediately complicates. This bodysuit mounts its petals across a white base, fitted through the body, with the floral detail doing the designing.

The construction is a straightforward bodysuit — snap or pull-on closure at the base, fitted line through the torso — and the petals are sewn flat so they lie the way they were placed rather than flying loose. White at this opacity reads as innocent from a distance and abandons the claim at conversation range, which is the standard bargain of the color.

Three sizes by weight band: S for 85–105 lbs, M for 105–120, L for 120–140. The bodysuit is the whole design; there is nothing to coordinate it with and nothing it needs.

The rundown:

  • Fabric: Polyester with petal detail
  • Style: Fitted bodysuit
  • Color: White
  • Sizes: S (85–105 lbs / 39–48 kg), M (105–120 lbs / 48–54 kg), L (120–140 lbs / 54–64 kg)

Bridal grammar, candid construction.
22020.short: White fitted bodysuit with sewn petal detailing, bridal-adjacent and sheer at range, in three sizes S to L for 85–140 lbs.
22020.tkd_title: White Petal Bodysuit in Three Sizes | RoseToys
22020.tkd_desc: White petal-detail bodysuit in three sizes for 85-140 lbs, sheer polyester with sewn-on floral detail. Direct from RoseToys.

22433.desc:
Transparency as a design language works best when nothing else competes with it, and this slip dress keeps the competition out: one sheer lace panel from shoulder to hem, a straight cut, and two colors that both know what they are doing. The design inventory ends there, deliberately.

The lace runs a steady openwork repeat, sheer enough that the slip is more suggestion than garment at any distance closer than arm's length. The cut is a one-piece skirt shape — fitted at the bust, straight through the body, and finished at a hem that keeps it in lingerie territory rather than eveningwear.

Black and red versions split between the genre's two default moods. One size covers the 40–60 kg band with the lace doing the absorbing, and the only maintenance decision is the cold wash.

Fast facts:

  • Fabric: Sheer lace
  • Style: One-piece slip dress
  • Colors: Black, red
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

One transparent idea, worn simply.
22433.short: One-piece sheer lace slip dress in black or red, straight cut with steady openwork repeat, one size for 40–60 kg.
22433.tkd_title: Sheer Lace Slip Dress in Two Colors | RoseToys

22434.title_note: high split split deep V 重复修正；nightdress+T-pants 组成→Set；三码真实围度展开
22434.desc:
A backless nightdress with a split hem covers the two directions a design can open — back and front — and lets the sides stay closed as the connective tissue. This piece does exactly that: a backless rear, a deep-V front, and split hems that move when the wearer does, with a matching T-back panty completing the set.

The measurements are unusually complete for the price class: M runs 70 cm long with a 70–100 cm bust, L runs 72 cm with an 80–110 cm bust, and XL runs 74 cm with an 85–120 cm bust, each with its waist range listed. In a lace piece with this many openings, those numbers are the difference between design and accident.

Black is the base color; the full color list follows the variant selector. Either way the set arrives as two pieces that were designed together, which at this category's price point is worth saying out loud.

The breakdown:

  • Fabric: Lace
  • Pieces: Nightdress and T-back panty
  • Key details: Backless, deep-V front, split hem
  • Sizes: M (length 70 cm, bust 70–100 cm, 40–55 kg), L (length 72 cm, bust 80–110 cm, 50–60 kg), XL (length 74 cm, bust 85–120 cm, 60–65 kg)

Open where it counts, closed where it must.

22439.title_note: open gear no-take 双误译→Open-Crotch；Material polyester（非 leather）以参数为准；三件组成回填
22439.desc:
Three-piece sets in black are the category's default configuration for a reason: bra, panty and a third element — here a breast patch — give a complete look with one purchase and one palette. This set runs that formula with an open-crotch construction in the base, which is the other default the genre rarely advertises this plainly.

The material is polyester rather than leather, which reads as leather-look styling: the same visual register at a weight and price that a wash cycle cannot threaten. Black throughout, with the three pieces matched in finish so the set reads as designed rather than assembled.

The breast patch is the piece that takes this from basic to specific — it is the detail that decides the look's register, and it is the first thing to leave if the evening heads that way. One size covers 40–65 kg.

What the set includes:

  • Fabric: Polyester, leather-look finish
  • Pieces: Bra, panties, breast patch
  • Key detail: Open-crotch construction
  • Color: Black
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–65 kg (88–143 lbs)

Three pieces, one palette, no ambiguity.

22459.desc:
A sheer lace nightdress needs exactly one strong decision — the sheerness — and the discipline to stop adding after that. This piece makes the decision and mostly keeps the discipline: an openwork lace body in a nightdress cut, with the transparency doing the design work from the first glance to the last.

The fit runs generous for the genre: a single size covering 40–70 kg, with the lace absorbing a range that fitted cuts would have to grade. The cut sits closer to a jumpsuit silhouette than a slip — more body, less skirt — which is what the wide band honest.

Three colors cover the standard register: black, red and white, each of which changes the openwork's visibility in its own direction. Whatever the color, the design is finished at the fabric choice; there is nothing on the piece to adjust and nothing that wants adjusting.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: Sheer openwork lace
  • Style: Nightdress, jumpsuit-adjacent cut
  • Colors: Black, red, white
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–70 kg (88–154 lbs)

One decision, seen through.

22487.new_name: Sheer Mesh Panel High-Slit Club Dress
22487.title_note: paneled→Panel 微调；perspective nightclub style→Club；clothing only 单件属实
22487.desc:
Mesh panels on a dress are how sheer fabric gets structure: the solid sections carry the fit, the mesh sections carry the effect, and the dress works because both know their jobs. This one places its panels along a high-slit silhouette in sheer mesh — a club cut that happens to live in the lingerie drawer.

The high slit is the design's other half, and it does for walking what the mesh does for standing still. Together they make a dress that photographs well from every angle the wearer chooses and from a few she does not — which is the standard deal with sheer paneling.

One size covers the 40–60 kg band, and the solid panels are where the fit lives, so the band is honest rather than optimistic. The color follows the listing; the effect does not.

The specifics:

  • Fabric: Sheer mesh with solid panels
  • Style: High-slit club dress
  • Colors: As pictured
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Structure where it fits, sheer where it counts.

22498.title_note: seduction suit 堆词剥；Item dress 单件→不写 Set；原26字符过短增强为品类+风格
22498.desc:
Every lingerie drawer ends up containing one plain lace slip that outlasts everything else in it, because the design has nothing to fail: no hardware to break, no strapping to tangle, no silhouette that dates. This nightdress is that piece — a classic lace slip in a straight cut, sold on the fabric and the longevity and nothing else.

The lace runs a traditional repeating pattern rather than a seasonal one, which is the difference between a nightdress and a trend. The cut hangs from the shoulder line and falls straight to the hem, with the fit generous enough for actual sleep — the use case that most sheer lace quietly abandons and this one does not.

One size covers the 40–60 kg band. The color follows the listing photos, and the care is the cold wash the fabric was always going to get.

The rundown:

  • Fabric: Traditional-pattern lace
  • Style: Slip nightdress
  • Colors: As pictured
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

The piece the drawer keeps when the rest rotates out.

22504.new_name: Steel-Boned Lace Corset Set in Two Colors
22504.title_note: steel to court（钢圈宫廷乱译）→Steel-Boned；Steel rim corset 参数回填；top+panties 组成→Set；双色属实
22504.desc:
Steel boning is what separates a corset from a crop top: the rigid vertical stays are the mechanism that shapes, and everything else — the lace, the lacing, the styling — is dressing on that chassis. This set builds on a steel-boned base with a lace overlay and a matching panty, in the two colors the genre recognizes.

Corsets ask one thing of their wearers: patience at the fitting. The boning holds its line rather than the body's, so the set is worn snug and adjusted once rather than pulled on and hoped about. The reward is a silhouette that knit fabrics cannot produce — structured, deliberate, and visibly engineered.

Black and red are the offerings, as tradition demands. One size covers the 40–60 kg band, which for a boned garment means the lacing does the fine adjustment within the band.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: Lace over steel boning
  • Pieces: Corset top and panty
  • Colors: Black, red
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Structure you can feel, silhouette you can see.
22504.short: Steel-boned lace corset set with matching panty, in black or red, one size for 40–60 kg with lacing for fine adjustment.
22504.tkd_title: Steel-Boned Lace Corset Set in Two Colors | RoseToys
22504.tkd_desc: Steel-boned lace corset set with matching panty, black or red, one size for 40-60 kg with lacing adjustment, at RoseToys.

22505.title_note: one-piece bunny girl→Costume Set；四件组成（headband+jumpsuit+tail+leg loop）回填；双色属实
22505.desc:
A bunny costume is an engineering problem disguised as a cliché: the ears must stand, the tail must stay, and the body of the suit must read as one glossy idea rather than three components on a theme. This set in patent leather solves all three — headband with ears, jumpsuit with an attached tail, and a leg loop to finish the line.

Patent leather is the correct fabric for the reference: the gloss is doing the costume's remembering, so the design can stay minimal everywhere the gloss is present. Red and black versions run theatrical and classic respectively, and both arrive as the complete look rather than a core piece with optional garnish.

One size covers the 40–60 kg band. The leg loop is the piece people forget to expect and the one that makes the costume read as finished — without it the costume is a jumpsuit with accessories, and the difference is visible.

The full listing includes:

  • Fabric: Patent leather
  • Pieces: Headband, jumpsuit, tail, leg loop
  • Colors: Red, black
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Four pieces, one cliché, fully committed.
22505.short: Four-piece patent leather bunny set — headband, jumpsuit, tail and leg loop — in red or black, one size for 40–60 kg.
22505.tkd_title: Patent Leather Bunny Costume Set | RoseToys
